assertions.name: delta_trM_vanishes_at_classical_point
assertions.source: Δtr_M(q=1) = 0 exactly — proton & neutron Markov traces coincide at the classical point q=1 (the q-space form of the #1622 d=2 bar-mode vanishing).

assertions.name: delta_trM_is_sqrt_u_ladder_order
assertions.source: Δtr_M leads at ε¹ while u_ladder is O(ε²), so Δtr_M is O(√u_ladder) — exactly the per-block order of the #1593 order audit. Confirms the c_k come from f(Δtr_M), not Δtr_M directly.

description: Change-of-variable bridge from the exact Habiro mode decomposition (u = q^{1/2}) to the Q_β ladder variable u_ladder = b·ℏ². Records Δtr_M(q) in closed form, both variable expansions around q=1, and the order-matching that unifies the order audit (#1593: Δtr_M is O(√u_ladder)), eigenphase≠f (#1602: f must lift √u to u² / bar-even), and the mode solve (#1622) into one consistent structural statement: Δtr_M(1)=0 exactly, Δtr_M is O(√u_ladder), so the c_k come from the scaling map f(Δtr_M), not Δtr_M directly. Exact symbolic; no fitted c_k.

order_matching.statement: Δtr_M is O(√u_ladder); c_k multiply u_ladder^k (k≥2); the scaling map f lifts √u_ladder→u_ladder², unifying #1593/#1602/#1622.

f_constraint.f_must: bar-even map lifting O(√u_ladder) Δtr_M to O(u_ladder²) ladder, reproducing ζ_4 residue ∓i/2 and bar-even content 1/2 (#1622)
